values.note: Request a site on the village's online form (pick site 1-8 electric or the non-electric site); pay by e-transfer, or cash/cheque/debit at the village office Tuesday-Friday 9-4.

values.note: Electric C$30 a night, C$150 a week (pay for 5, stay 7), C$600 a month; non-electric C$15 a night.

fees.source: https://villageofmaryfield.com/camping/ ('Electrical Sites $30 per night $150 per week (pay for 5, stay for 7) $600 per month Non-Service Sites $15 per night'), read 2026-11-18

note: Small Village of Maryfield / Lions Club campground at the NE corner of town, 0.5 km south of Hwy 48, in a tree-lined grassy area beside the ballpark. The electric sites need an RV adapter. --Claude
summary: Keep (village/Lions). 9 sites (8 x 30 A + water, 1 non-electric); C$15/30 (weekly/monthly too); village online booking form (was fcfs always); season May 15 - Sep 30 (Tourism Sask). Not waterfront kept. Pin fine on the gravel loop. Google 4.7 (6).
